details.description:
Mars Chocolate Bar is an indulgent treat featuring nougat and caramel covered in rich milk chocolate. It consists of 40% Milk Chocolate, 33% Nougat and 27% Caramel. Mars, with this delicious fusion, gives you a reason to feel good about it in each bite. With light nougat, smooth caramel and a thin, crispy chocolate layer on top, the bar is light yet satisfying. 
This chocolatey deliciousness can be enjoyed occasionally as part of a balanced diet and healthy lifestyle. Additionally, Mars chocolate candy bars are a tasty way to add delicious fun to your everyday celebrations. There's no way you would want to miss the pleasure of savouring this yummy treat at the office, at home or even on the go. Storage: Store in a cool, dry place.
details.ingredients: Milk Chocolate Coating (sugar, Milk Solids(Full Cream Milk Powder, Lactose, Whey Powder, Milk Fat), Cocoa Butter, Cocoa Mass, Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin (e322)), Natural Vanilla Extract), Centre Filling (Glucose Syrup, Sugar, Milk Solids (Skimmed Milk Powder, Milk Fat, Lactose, Whey Powder, Milk Protein), Sunflower Oil, Fat Reduced Cocoa, Barley Malt Extract, Salt, Egg White Powder, Palm Fat, Natural Vanilla Extract.
details.usageInstructions: Mars chocolate is perfect to snack on at work, post-meal, while binge-watching or playing virtual games.

details.description: Bring home the vegetarian Mars Bar, now made for every Indian household with the same iconic taste & signature layers loved around the world. Rich milk chocolate, creamy caramel, & light whipped nougat come together in one iconic chocolate bar. Whether you're celebrating a milestone or embracing a new challenge, Mars is the chocolate companion that uplifts every occasion and celebrates you.
